How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/BTech/ME/MTech degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering or a related discipline to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JRA position at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Assistant post is 28 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Assistant position involves an interview and document verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT BHU JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is to be done via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position announced by IIT BHU.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT BHU located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position at IIT BHU is a contractual job. The duration of the contract is not specified in the provided data.
